tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rgya nag po'i skag zlog ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya nag po'i skag zlog ces bya ba/ 'phags pa kun la phyag 'tshal lo// rig byed kun gyis bskyab tu gsol// mchog po kun la phyag 'tshal lo// bar snang lha yis bskyab tu gsol// tshangs rigs lha la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum srid la dbang sgyur ba// kun la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin// rgyu skar thams cad bzang ba yin// sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis// bdag cag kun tu bde legs shog /oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ ma he dpal 'bar ma ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ka li mo ta ye swā hā/ o a ka ni ni ka ni a bi ya maṇ+ḍa le swā hā/ oṃ zin du srungs shig /oṃ du du na srungs shig /oṃ dar du srung shig /oṃ tsu ti srungs shig /oṃ du ma srungs shig /oṃ pra ti srungs shig /oṃ su dā dan tri srungs shig /oṃ na tshan srungs shig /oṃ su la kha srungs shig /oṃ kha la tri srungs shig /oṃ tre du she du srungs shig /oṃ kha ti srungs shig /oṃ ltar ltar srungs shig /oṃ ma pa sha ye srungs shig /oṃ ka nan ta srungs shig /oṃ bha la srungs shig /oṃ ta la bha srungs shig /oṃ ra srungs shag /oṃ ra tri srungs shig /oṃ ma ra srungs shig /oṃ ma rig srungs shig /oṃ smra ti srungs shig /oṃ ta ne srungs shig /oṃ bha ta srungs shig /srid gsum mgon gyi rgyu/ pi pi ling ga ga rjes la gi /khro chu phan sems can ma'i gnas sgrubs shig /mthun dang mi mthun shis dang mi shis gzugs lag ma'i gnas// bdag gis lhas srungs shig /skyobs shig /oṃ trag tu tre ye swā hā/ oṃ tre'u zlog /oṃ trag rak+ṣa zlog /oṃ ma ma kyi ta zlog /oṃ ma sur+ya zlog /oṃ a tsan+d+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ pu par ta ye swā hā/ oṃ pri ti shati swā hā/ oṃ ma ma sngo ta sngo ta ye swā hā/

oṃ ma ma raṃ raṃ ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma ka ra ka ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma char chur yar yer swā hā/ oṃ ma ma su su taṃ taṃ ye swā hā/ oṃ yaṃ yaṃ sa la ge re du ye te khu che phaṭa/ zhi zhi yang du ma hā raṃ raṃ ge ra tsa sa phaṭa/ gha dha seng gi zhi ba 'dus na ma sa du ye ma ra da ke khang de 'du/ ba ro si ma du hri/ nag mo chems kham du a a ma da pe rim/ khreng du ma a ra khyer na yu/ a hūṃ khye sha na ma ma ho// a pa sa ra sa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ ma rak+ṣa/ ma ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ bhar+ya dha ma ma ye/ dha ke tsa ra ya phaṭa/ bdag la 'byung ba lnga po'i dgra gshed 'joms shing yongs su skyobs/ oṃ a ga ni dha ra sha ma ra ya sa bcings ma tra kre ya na ya phaṭa/ nag po bzhi ghu ta ya/ ma ta ya mal mal zhi zhi swā hā/ ā yur yu te a kur zhi ha le/ sa su tri phaṭa/ oṃ oṃ hūṃ ke raṃ te phaṭa/ dha dha na ma sa ra ma sa te/ da ha na na hūṃ hūṃ zhi zhi mal mal nag po zhi/ pur he ni ha ha na swā hā/ zhi dha la ma du se phaṭa/ me a rak+ṣa si ma du ye/ nag po zhi sa ma ye a na phaṭa/ gu ma gu te nag po zhi/ oṃ hūṃ sarba rak+ṣa hūṃ/ dha dha na dha ho/ me he ma ho rak+ṣa rbad/ zhi zhi dul dul sa hā lhan/ oṃ na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo dharma ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ a nan te/ tad+ya thā/ a ka ra na sad/ sa bha sa pra dharma ni sa/ sarba tā thā/ oṃ sho dha bi bu sha/ bi ma le tsa le/ ru lu ru lu/ bi shi ta/ man+ta/ oṃ laṃ muṃ/ sa ra dza ye swā hā/ oṃ tra ya mig tir ye swā hā/ oṃ tra ma le swā hā/ oṃ traṃ bhe la rā dza ye swā hā/ oṃ khaṃ nyer ra ye swā hā/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// mi mthun pa yi phyogs rnams ni// bskal pa me yis sreg pa ltar// thams cad de yi mod la 'byor// 'dod don zla ba rgyas bzhin 'phel// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// ma klungs kyis rtsub pa zlog /bu klungs kyis rtsub pa zlog /gnod sbyin pha tshe 'phrog pa zlog

/srin mo mi ru brdzu ba zlog /srin mo sha rkya mda' 'phen zlog /kungs lam 'khor ba ru log zlog /lus kyi 'khor lo zhig pa zlog /dbang thang zas kha yul nyes zlog /klungs rta'i rgyal mtshan chag pa zlog /bla yi rgyab rten yar ba zlog /khams kyi slog pa ral ba zla go /rang skag gis rtsub pa zlog /mthun gsum gyis rtsub pa zlog /bdun zur gyis rtsub pa zlog /dgra ngan gyis rtsub pa zlog /bzhi gshed kyis rtsub pa zlog /phyogs ngan gyis rtsub pa zlog /bdud gcod kyis rtsub pa zlog /'dre lngas rtsub pa zlog /lus chad kyis rtsub pa zlog /gnam sgos rtsub pa zlog /sa sgos rtsub pa zlog /gshed skos rtsub pa zlog /phung gyod gyis rtsub pa zlog /dus tshod kyis rtsub pa zlog /mya ngan gyis rtsub pa zlog /lcags bzhis rtsub pa zlog /me brgyad kyis rtsub pa zlog /ngan klungs kyis rtsub pa zlog /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ pha mes rgan gyi 'dre gcan gyis rtsub pa zlog /lo skag gis rtsub pa zlog /zla skag gis rtsub pa zlog /zhag skag gis rtsub pa zlog /za skag gis rtsub pa zlog /dus skag gis rtsub pa zlog /bdud skag gis rtsub pa zlog /gza' dang skar mas rtsub pa zlog /nyi mas rtsub pa zlog /zla bas rtsub pa zlog /dur mig tu tshud pa zlog /srog dur mig tu tshud pa zlog /lus dur mig tu tshud pa zlog /dbang thang dur mig tu tshud pa zlog /klungs rta dur mig tu tshud pa zlog /na mig tu tshud pa zlog /shi mig tu tshud pa zlog /srog la dgra dar ba zlog /klungs rta la dgra dar ba zlog /lus la dgra dar ba zlog /dbang thang la dgra dar ba zlog /khams la dgra dar ba zlog /lo la dgra dar ba zlog /zla ba la dgra dar ba zlog /zhag la dgra dar ba zlog /dus tshod la dgra dar ba zlog /re 'dod kyis rtsub pa zlog /chung skag che la rtsub pa zlog /rje skag 'bangs la rtsub pa zlog /'bangs skag rje la rtsub pa zlog

/pha skag bu la rtsub pa zlog /bu skag pha la rtsub pa zlog /khyo bo'i chung ma la rtsub pa zlog /chung ma'i skag khyo bo la rtsub pa zlog /ma'i skag bu mo la rtsub pa zlog /bu mo'i skag ma la rtsub pa zlog /ming po'i skag sring mo la rtsub pa zlog /sring mo'i skag ming po la rtsub pa zlog /bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la li khen bdud mda' 'phen pa zlog /'khor la phying dum gril ba zlog /dwa zin gri phur 'debs pa zlog /ging zin mdud nag bsnol ba zlog /spar kha brgyad kyi dgu mig tu tshud pa zlog /sme ba dgu'i dgu mig tu tshud pa zlog /lo'i dgu mig tu tshud pa zlog /che ba dgu mig tu tshud pa zlog /chung ba dgu mig tu tshud pa zlog /bud med dgu mig tu tshud pa zlog /khye'u dgu mig tu tshud pa zlog /dur mig tu tshud pa zlog /rgan pa la chags che ba brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa zlog /skyes pa dar ma la chags che ba sum cu rtsa bdun pa zlog /byis pa la chags che ba dgu thog tu babs pa bzlog /bud med rgan pa la chags che ba drug cu rtsa gcig pa zlog /bu mo gzhon pa la chags che ba bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa zlog /bu mo chung ba la chags che ba nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zlog /me pho 'brug thog tu kungs sa phyin pa zlog /'u chu khams pa phyin pa zlog /'u 'dus mo bshang thog tu phyin pa zlog /shing lcags pa me mo lug thog tu phyin pa zlog /dwa dang sa khyi 'phrad pa zlog /kham dang me mo lug 'phrad pa zlog /sa mo glang thog tu gri sgo bye ba zlog /kham dang lcags pho 'brug 'phrad pa zlog /khon dang lcags pho khyi 'phrad pa zlog /gin dang lcags mo lug 'phrad pa zlog /zin dang chu pho khyi thog bdud gnam babs kyi dgu mig zlog /zon dang chu mo glang smyo 'bog gri gshom gyi dgu mig zlog /li dang shing pho 'brug thog tu bdud gnam babs kyi dgu mig zlog /kham dang me glang g.yu 'phreng thag pa chad pa'i dgu mig zlog

/khen dang sa pho 'brug mna' zos bu che'i dgu mig zlog /dwa dang sa mo lug mo rabs chad kyi dgu mig zlog /khon dang lcags pho khyi spyang mo ngu zug byed pa'i dgu mig zlog /li dang lcags mo glang khyim bdag dog sar babs pa'i dgu mig zlog /zon dang chu pho 'brug nad ngo 'byung ba'i dgu mig zlog /zin dang chu mo lug khyim bdag mo grir 'chi ba'i dgu mig zlog /gin dang shing pho khyi bu 'byung thang lhung rabs chad kyi dgu mig zlog /kham dang shing mo glang yug sa gnam babs kyi dgu mig zlog /dgu dang po nyon mongs thang khol gyi bu'i gnod pa zlog /dgu gnyis bco brgyad pa mngal nag 'byung ba'i bu'i gnod pa zlog /dgu gsum nyer bdun pa gri ro sgor skyel gyi bu'i gnod pa zlog /dgu bzhi so drug pa rje'i gdan sa 'phrog pa'i bu'i gnod pa zlog /dgu lnga zhe lnga pa gnam kyi rnga zor gyi bu'i gnod pa zlog /dgu drug lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa pho lha ngur 'bod kyi bu'i gnod pa zlog /dgu bdun drug cu rtsa gsum pa grir shi dur sgo 'khrug pa'i bu'i gnod pa zlog /dgu brgyad bdun cu don gnyis pa sdang ba mang la byams pa nyung ba'i bu'i gnod pa zlog /dgu dgu brgyad bcu gya gcig pa btson gyi jag pa khyim nas 'don bu'i gnod pa zlog /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dgu mig dur na sdod pa zlog /dgu mig phur kyis 'debs pa zlog /dgu mig 'phying dum gril ba zlog /lcags kyi dgu mig gri dang mel ldang ba zlog /me'i dgu mig skam nad yams nad sdod pa zlog /shing gi dgu mig glo bur ye 'brog yong ba zlog /chu'i dgu mig mya ngan chu nad yong ba zlog /sa'i dgu mig lci 'thibs kyi nad 'byung ba zlog /khams kyi dgu mig dur du tshud pa zlog /dgu mig rkyen gyi sgo mo zlog /lhas mi 'tshong gis mi btsongs pa zlog /bdud mi nyo yis mi nyos pa zlog

/lus kyi rten phur phyungs pa zlog /srog gi ljon shing chag pa zlog /dbang thang gi ra ba ral ba zlog /klungs rta'i rgyal mtshan chag pa zlog /lo rgyal pos gdan bshams pa zlog /zla ba blon pos gros byas pa zlog /zhag dmag mis dmag bshams pa zlog /dus tshod mtshon cha btab pa zlog /spar kha'i a thang chad pa zlog /khongs pa srin gyis zos pa zlog /bdud kyi phung 'dre 'bebs pa zlog /'dre lnga bya ra byed pa zlog /nag po ne tsho 'jug pa zlog /bdud kyi sha ro dngos su bskyangs pa zlog /khyim nag khol du gtib pa zlog /brgya ba mang gis gleng ba zlog /stong mig mang gis blta ba zlog /sdang ba dgra yis sgrog tu bcug pa zlog /byams pa gnyen gyis brjod pa zlog /gdags ri dkar po las brag ral bzlog /srib ri nag po las shing chag pa zlog /mi rje sa bdag rgyal po'i mnga' thang nyams pa zlog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdan sa stongs pa zlog /btsun pa'i 'dul khrims zhig pa zlog /sman pa'i dpyad ka log pa zlog /rtsis kyi skor 'go 'dzol ba zlog /gshen rab lha gral stongs pa zlog /gnam rim pa dgu'i steng nas shel gyi bya khyung gshog pa brdeb pa zlog /sa rim pa dgu'i 'og nas dur phag nag po 'khun pa zlog /zangs kyi glang po rwa brdar ba zlog /phu nas dgra byung ba zlog /glo bur snga nas sri langs pa zlog /dur sa gnyan po kha bye ba zlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlog /glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /gdon rigs stong phrag sum brgya zlog /mi phyugs spyi yi sri ngan zlog /grong tsho dgrar langs sri ngan zlog /phyogs bcu'i sde 'khrug langs pa zlog /dus ngan lta srid ngan pa zlog /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /byad ngan sbyor rtsub byad kha phur kha bzlog /mna'i chad pa gtad khram ngan sngags zlog /mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus zhi gyur cig /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis gsungs pa'i rgya nag skag zlog ces bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /
